channel.title: Blockheight
channel.description: Blockheight reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and market structure.

item.title: How to Verify a Mantle Bridge Deposit Network
item.description: Verify a Mantle deposit by matching its source transaction, destination address and network in the explorers; a token ticker alone does not confirm the transfer.

item.title: How Integrators Schedule Cross-Chain Transfers Under Load
item.description: Integrators schedule cross-chain transfers by pricing routes, reserving liquidity and pacing submissions as congestion changes cost, delivery time and failure risk.

item.title: How Businesses Should Reconcile Cross-Chain Transfers
item.description: Reconcile a cross-chain transfer by matching source and destination records, accounting for fees and timing, and documenting exceptions before closing the books.

item.title: Paying a merchant from the wrong chain
item.description: When checkout names the wrong network, match the merchant’s chain first, then bridge or swap only after checking the asset, fees and final recipient.

item.title: Four Checks When a Crypto Withdrawal Review Delays Funding
item.description: A crypto withdrawal review can pause funding for identity, risk or network checks; these four steps help identify the hold, avoid duplicate requests and see what to do next.

item.title: BTC to native ETH requires a swap, not a bridge
item.description: BTC does not become native ETH through a bridge: swap it for ETH, then receive it on Ethereum mainnet; bridged BTC remains a separate token.

item.title: Why Wallet Transfers Stay Pending During Bridge Maintenance
item.description: Bridge maintenance can pause wallet transfers across chains while operators check settlement queues, finality and the route before retrying a transfer.

item.title: Schedule treasury transfers around bridge settlement
item.description: Schedule crypto treasury transfers for when funds must arrive, then reconcile bridge settlement separately; delivery and final reimbursement can follow different clocks.

item.title: Ripple Prime launches 24/7 swaps across 100 RWA markets
item.description: Ripple Prime says institutions can trade 24/7 swaps across more than 100 traditional-asset markets, using Hyperliquid-listed futures as references and RLUSD as collateral.

item.title: Where Should You Move Tokens After a Migration?
item.description: Choose a post-migration destination by checking the new contract, network, custody support, fees, liquidity and deadline before moving or swapping tokens.

item.title: Crypto Bridges Require Gas on the Sending Chain
item.description: Bridging usually requires the source chain’s native token for the send; destination gas depends on the route, so check fees and keep funds for follow-up actions.

item.title: EBA puts Circle’s USDC under significant-token rules
item.description: The EBA named Circle’s USDC the EU’s first significant e-money token under MiCA, moving key reserve and liquidity oversight to the EU level from November 12.

item.title: Which Crypto Bridge Route Fits a $200 Transfer?
item.description: A $200 bridge has no universal cheapest route: chains, token choice, gas and slippage decide what arrives, so compare live net-output quotes before signing.

item.title: Manta bridge or bridge then swap: what to do with a stuck transfer
item.description: A stuck cross-chain transfer may need a status check, a retry, or a separate swap; choose a route by where the funds are and which asset you need.

item.title: XRP Ledger fixes bug that could have minted trillions
item.description: XRPL says its 3.4.1 update fixed a payment overflow that could create spendable XRP, and developers found no evidence of exploitation on public networks.

item.title: DRW and Marex complete Canton swap on tokenized iBoxx index
item.description: DRW and Marex completed a total return swap on Canton tied to a tokenized iBoxx credit index, testing on-chain trade records and valuation for OTC derivatives.

item.title: Standard Chartered launches RLUSD custody in Dubai
item.description: Standard Chartered has opened RLUSD custody for eligible institutional clients in Dubai and plans an LMAX link that would let them use tokens as trading collateral.

item.title: XRPL fixes payment bug that could have created 18 trillion XRP
item.description: XRPL's 3.4.1 patch blocks a payment overflow that could create spendable XRP; the flaw dated to 2015, and developers found no evidence of public exploitation.

item.title: Orca and Loopscale Merge as Formation to Target Frontier Finance
item.description: Orca and Loopscale will operate as Formation, combining Solana trading, credit and vault tools to finance assets in AI, energy, robotics and defense.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates with six $1 million pledges
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for midterm support, including six $1 million commitments, as Senate crypto rules remain stalled after September's failed vote.
